attributes.name: list item horizontal arrangement
attributes.definition: How the parts of a single post/news item are laid out horizontally within its row or strip.

values.definition: Items are titles only (with a leading label) laid out in a single horizontal run.
Item split into left, middle and right zones (e.g. date, headline, action).
Item parts stacked vertically or in a card.

attributes.name: overflow handling of items
attributes.definition: How content that exceeds the available width is treated.

values.definition: Items are clipped or cut off at the container edge.
Content is sized to fit the row with no truncation, no wrapping.

attributes.name: accent-coloured text element
attributes.definition: Presence and role of an accent-coloured label or link within the item list.

values.definition: Accent-coloured read-more/action link at the end of each item.

attributes.name: vertical alignment in row
attributes.definition: How row contents are aligned on the vertical axis.

values.definition: Row contents centred on the vertical axis.
Contents aligned to top or baseline.
